Headline: GLOBAL CHIP SHORTAGE THREATENS INDUSTRY
Description: A sudden shortage of advanced semiconductors is stalling factories worldwide. Your economic and national security advisors are waiting in the Situation Room for a decision.

Options.Label: Subsidize Domestic Production
Options.Description: Pour treasury funds into domestic chip fabrication to reduce reliance on foreign supply.
Options.ResultingHeadline: PRESIDENT ANNOUNCES DOMESTIC CHIP SUBSIDIES - MARKETS CAUTIOUSLY OPTIMISTIC

Options.Label: Negotiate International Supply Agreement
Options.Description: Broker a multilateral agreement to stabilize the global chip supply chain.
Options.ResultingHeadline: PRESIDENT BROKERS INTERNATIONAL CHIP SUPPLY PACT

Options.Label: Do Nothing
Options.Description: Let markets correct the shortage on their own.
Options.ResultingHeadline: WHITE HOUSE DECLINES TO INTERVENE AS CHIP SHORTAGE WORSENS
